intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Gujarat by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at only {{colleges}} public colleges.
IIM Ahmedabad dominates this short list. The other two campuses are Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, Surat, and the GH Patel Postgraduate Institute of Business Management, Anand.
listLead: IIM Ahmedabad appears first. The opening card may be an executive PGPX row rather than the flagship PGP, so read the programme name before you compare packages.
snapshot: Only {{colleges}} colleges are on this page, so we have not quoted a package median in this text. The three recorded averages should be read one by one, with the year of each official report.
IIM Ahmedabad is 1st in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. That is the right context when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Gujarat 2026 on this government list.
firstCollegesLead: For IIM Ahmedabad, our table shows a 2024 average of ₹36 LPA and a highest of ₹55 LPA on a recorded MBA Finance row, with a recorded total fee of ₹26.50 lakh. Confirm the flagship PGP figures in the official placement report and fee notice.

Veer Narmad South Gujarat University has a 2022 recorded average of ₹2 LPA, and GH Patel Institute a 2023 recorded average of ₹4 LPA. Those years and figures need a check against the latest official reports.

sections.heading: Why this Gujarat list is so short
paragraphs: A government package list can only include public colleges with a recorded average package. In Gujarat, our file currently qualifies only three campuses.
Other government or university departments may exist, but they are not on this page until we hold a usable average package for them.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Gujarat
paragraphs: IIM Ahmedabad is not comparable with a state university MBA on package alone. Compare the programme, the official fee and the year of the data.
bullets: Whether you are looking at the flagship PGP or an executive programme such as PGPX.
The official placement report year, not only the average on our card.
The official fee notice; our IIM Ahmedabad recorded total of ₹26.50 lakh should be confirmed against the current official notice.
CAT and each institute's own interview process.

faqs.question: How many government MBA colleges in Gujarat are on this list?
faqs.answer: Our records link {{count}} programme options at only {{colleges}} public colleges: IIM Ahmedabad, Veer Narmad South Gujarat University, and the GH Patel Institute in Anand.

faqs.question: What package does IIM Ahmedabad show here?
faqs.answer: Our table records a 2024 average of ₹36 LPA and a highest of ₹55 LPA for an MBA Finance row. Confirm the official PGP placement report, because an executive programme can sit first on a card.

faqs.question: What is IIM Ahmedabad's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Ahmedabad is ranked 1.

faqs.question: Why is there no package median on this page?
faqs.answer: Only three colleges have a recorded average package here, which is too few for a stable median. Read each official report instead of a single mid-point figure.
